name: sco-compliance-os
description: SCO Compliance OS — Compliance OS for AI. Proprietario SCO Solution Consulting srls.
author: SCO Solution Consulting srls

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn sco_compliance_os.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7800
scripts.build:msi: pnpm build:backend && pnpm --filter ./frontend tauri build --bundles msi && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/copy-msi-to-kdrive.ps1
scripts.build:msi:no-copy: pnpm build:backend && pnpm --filter ./frontend tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.build:dmg: pnpm build:backend && pnpm --filter ./frontend tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.build:appimage: pnpm build:backend && pnpm --filter ./frontend tauri build --bundles appimage
scripts.clean: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force frontend/dist, frontend/src-tauri/target, backend/dist, backend/build -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
